linework.observation: Clean heavy contours define protagonist, crew stations, console banks and hatch.

colour.observation: FAIL: saturated red illumination washes across the room and surfaces, exceeding restrained palette even for emergency light.

shading.observation: Cel-shaded figures and equipment, with broad red glow adding excessive gradients.

character_construction.observation: The protagonist is clearly bald and distinct from supporting crew.

backgrounds.observation: Enclosed control room with sonar displays and watch stations.

finish.observation: Readable outlined equipment, but red glow dominates visual hierarchy.

identity.observation: Bald protagonist matches the identity sheet; supporting crew have hair.

content.observation: Crew at sonar stations and the protagonist relaying a watch message fit the setting.

composition.observation: Wide view holds central operator and other stations in frame.

regions.people_faces: Bald protagonist centered with handset; two dark-haired operators at consoles.
regions.foreground_props: Clipboard, handset, radar screens and logbook.
regions.architecture: Enclosed steel control room with equipment banks.
regions.distance: Rear stations layer behind the focal character.
regions.lighting: Room-wide saturated red glow needs replacement with neutral work lighting and only dim red indicators.

correction: Keep the control-room watch activity, central bald protagonist and supporting crew. Change global red illumination to subdued cream work lamps, charcoal and steel gray. Limit red to a few small dim status lights. Preserve the muted 2D outlined style and current composition.
